How we cut widget boot time by 70 percent

Widget firmware used to verify every flash block on boot. We switched to a Merkle tree over the firmware image so the bootloader verifies only the root hash and lazily checks blocks on first read.

Boot time dropped from eleven seconds to just over three seconds on the WX-2048 hardware.
